column3: “Concerning all things” is rendered “in all respects,” and “do well” “prosper.”
“Brothers” is rendered “brethren”; NASB adds “that is, how.”
NASB follows the critical text (“the truth”); it supplies “this.”
NASB follows the critical text (“and especially when they are strangers”); “do” is rendered “accomplish.”
“Having set forward” is rendered “to send them on their way.”
NASB follows the critical text (“the Gentiles”); “the name” is capitalized.
NASB follows the critical text (“support”); “in the truth” is rendered “with the truth.”
NASB follows the critical text (“something”); “welcomes us” is rendered “does not accept what we say.”
“Prating against us” is rendered “unjustly accusing us”; NASB supplies “to do so.”
NASB follows the critical text, without “now.”
NASB follows the critical text (“you know”); NASB supplies “good.”
NASB adds the greetings of verse 15 (“Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.”) to this verse.
NASB has no separate verse 15; its words are at the end of verse 14.
